title: Web search in Microsoft Copilot: what leaves the tenant, and who can switch it off?
summary: The documented defaults, governance paths, commands and Bing data handling support publication. One minor qualification needs narrowing: the exclusion of Copilot Chat from document-informed searches relies on a web-search article whose description of Chat's organizational-content access differs from Microsoft's overview.

claims.claim: Web search is an optional feature allowing Copilot and Copilot Chat to reference web content in responses.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat have an optional feature that allows Copilot to reference web content when responding to user prompts.

claims.claim: When web search is enabled, Copilot and Copilot Chat may retrieve information from Bing to ground responses.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat may fetch information from the Bing search service when information from the web helps to provide a better, more grounded response.

claims.claim: Microsoft also calls the use of web information for grounding responses web grounding.
claims.quote: By using domain exclusion, you can specify up to 1,000 sites to exclude from web grounding in Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat through a PowerShell script.

claims.where: What it is: How a search is made
claims.claim: Copilot parses the prompt and identifies terms where web information would improve the response.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat parse the user's prompt and identifies terms where information from the web would improve the quality of the response.

claims.where: What it is: How a search is made; summary
claims.claim: Copilot generates a query of a few words from the prompt and sends it to Bing.
claims.quote: Copilot generates a search query that it sends to the Bing search service asking for more information. This generated search query is different from the user's original prompt-it consists of a few words informed by the user's prompt.

claims.where: What it is: How a search is made
claims.claim: The generated query excludes the entire prompt unless it is very short.
claims.quote: The following information isn't included in the generated search query sent to the Bing search service: ... The user's entire prompt, unless the prompt is very short (for example, "local weather")

claims.where: What it is: How a search is made
claims.claim: The generated query excludes entire Microsoft 365 files.
claims.quote: Entire Microsoft 365 files (for example, emails or documents) or files uploaded into Copilot

claims.where: What it is: How a search is made
claims.claim: The generated query excludes identifying Entra ID information such as username, domain and tenant ID.
claims.quote: Any identifying information based on the user's Microsoft Entra ID (for example, username, domain, or tenant ID)

claims.where: What it is: How a search is made
claims.claim: Copilot sends the user's client IP address to Bing.
claims.quote: When Copilot sends a web search request to the Bing search service, it also sends the user's client IP address

claims.claim: A Copilot query may be informed by document data when the user prompts inside a Microsoft 365 app with a relevant document open.
claims.quote: When a user enters a prompt into Copilot inside a Microsoft 365 application (for example, writing a prompt into Copilot in Microsoft Word while a relevant document is open).

claims.claim: A Copilot query may be informed by document data when the user explicitly references a specific document.
claims.quote: However, it may also be informed by data within a Microsoft 365 document under the following conditions: ... When the user explicitly references a specific document in their prompt.

claims.claim: The document-informed query explanation is restricted to Copilot, not Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: Unlike with Microsoft Copilot, users can't invoke organizational content like files, emails, or chats, when prompting in Microsoft Copilot Chat.
claims.fix: Remove '(not Chat)' so the sentence starts 'In Microsoft Copilot, the query can still be informed by data in a document'. The cited article supports the Copilot conditions, but https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/plan/copilot-overview says Chat can use explicitly provided organizational content and open content in Teams and Outlook; it does not establish how that content informs Chat's web queries.

claims.where: What it is: Copilot Search distinction
claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot Search is a separate search experience from the web-search feature described here.
claims.quote: This article concerns the web search functionality in Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat. Microsoft Copilot Search is an additional, universal search experience

claims.where: What it is: Copilot Search distinction
claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot Search searches Microsoft 365 and third-party data sources.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot Search is an additional, universal search experience that allows users with a Microsoft Copilot license to search across all their Microsoft 365 and third-party data sources.

claims.where: What it is: Copilot Search distinction
claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot Search is available to users with a Microsoft Copilot licence.
claims.quote: allows users with a Microsoft Copilot license to search across all their Microsoft 365 and third-party data sources

claims.claim: Generated web queries go to Bing, which operates separately from Microsoft 365.
claims.quote: The Bing search service operates separately from Microsoft 365 and has different data-handling practices. The web search queries generated by Copilot and sent to Bing are subject to the Microsoft Services Agreement

claims.claim: Bing has different data-handling practices from Microsoft 365.
claims.quote: The Bing search service operates separately from Microsoft 365 and has different data-handling practices.

claims.claim: The Data Protection Addendum does not apply to generated web-search queries.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Products and Services Data Protection Addendum (DPA) doesn't apply to the use of generated web search queries in Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Copilot Chat, or the Bing search service.

claims.claim: HIPAA compliance does not apply to generated search queries.
claims.quote: Also, HIPAA compliance and the EU Data Boundary don't apply to generated search queries.

claims.claim: The EU Data Boundary does not apply to generated search queries.
claims.quote: Also, HIPAA compliance and the EU Data Boundary don't apply to generated search queries.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risks and limits: Unset can mean on
claims.claim: In commercial tenants, an unset web-search policy permits search unless the additional optional connected-experiences policy is Disabled.
claims.quote: If the IT admin doesn't configure the Allow web search in Copilot policy, web search will be available to users in both Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat, unless the IT admin has set the Allow the use of additional optional connected experiences in Office policy to Disabled.

claims.where: Why it matters; What to check: GCC or DoD
claims.claim: In GCC and DoD, web search remains off until the Allow web search in Copilot policy is configured.
claims.quote: For United States government customers ... GCC or DoD offerings: ... If you don't configure the Allow web search in Copilot policy, web search remains turned off, regardless of how the Allow the use of additional optional connected experiences in Office policy is configured.

claims.claim: The tenant's Allow web search in Copilot policy controls whether Copilot and Copilot Chat users or groups can use web search.
claims.quote: This policy allows IT admins to either turn on or turn off web search for users or user groups across the tenant they manage ... This policy applies to both Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat.

claims.where: Why it matters; controls[2].governs; summary; What to check
claims.claim: DLP can block external web search for Copilot prompts containing configured sensitive information types.
claims.quote: When a user prompt contains the configured SITs, Copilot and Cowork block external web search as a grounding source and continue to generate the response using allowed internal Microsoft 365 data sources.

claims.where: Why it matters; controls[1].governs; Risks and limits; summary
claims.claim: Domain exclusions filter returned web-page results rather than preventing the generated query from being sent.
claims.quote: Currently, domain exclusions support filtering on web page results only. Results from other answer verticals, such as news, might still be cited.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a separate licence requirement specific to this web-search capability.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Copilot Copilot Chat web search licensing pricing meter Bing search charge. Opened manage-public-web-access, microsoft-copilot-requirements and copilot-overview; they describe product eligibility, not a separate web-search licence.

claims.claim: A meter or charge specific to Copilot web search has not been published as of this check.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Copilot Copilot Chat web search licensing pricing meter Bing search charge. Opened manage-public-web-access, microsoft-copilot-requirements, copilot-overview and pay-as-you-go-meters; none states a meter specific to this capability.

claims.claim: Microsoft describes admin controls and the Web content toggle as available to eligible Copilot and Copilot Chat users.
claims.quote: Admin controls and a user-level Web content toggle are available for eligible Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat users.

claims.claim: The Copilot License Details diagnostic checks whether a user account meets applicable Copilot licensing requirements.
claims.quote: Use the Copilot License Details diagnostic to check whether a user account meets applicable licensing requirements for Copilot features.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy supports most Microsoft 365 subscription plans that include Microsoft 365 Apps.
claims.quote: Cloud Policy supports most Microsoft 365 subscription plans that include Microsoft 365 Apps. Check your licensing documentation for specific requirements.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy does not support Microsoft 365 operated by 21Vianet.
claims.quote: The following plans are not supported: ... Microsoft 365 operated by 21Vianet

claims.claim: The Copilot DLP documentation refers to Microsoft 365 service descriptions for licensing.
claims.quote: For information on licensing, see ... Microsoft 365 Enterprise Plans ... Microsoft 365 Service Descriptions

claims.claim: Disabling optional connected experiences restricts multiple Microsoft 365 experiences as well as Copilot.
claims.quote: But turning off optional connected experiences restricts Microsoft Copilot Chat, Microsoft Copilot, and multiple experiences across Microsoft 365.

claims.claim: The per-user optional connected-experiences privacy setting has no effect on web-search availability.
claims.quote: The privacy setting for optional connected experiences available to users in Microsoft 365 apps (for example, in Word, Excel, or Teams) has no effect on the availability of web search.

claims.where: Risks and limits: Users can only narrow; controls[3].governs
claims.claim: A user can turn off Web content even when the administrator permits web search.
claims.quote: If the IT admin turns on web search for Microsoft Copilot users, those users still have the option to turn off web search by using the Web content toggle.

claims.where: Risks and limits: Users can only narrow; controls[3].note
claims.claim: The IT-admin section describes the admin-disabled Web content toggle as turned off and dimmed.
claims.quote: If the IT admin turns off web search, the Web content toggle is turned off and appears dimmed.

claims.where: Risks and limits: Users can only narrow; controls[3].note
claims.claim: The user-toggle section describes the admin-disabled Web content toggle as unavailable.
claims.quote: If the IT admin disables web search, the Web content toggle isn't available to the user and web search is disabled.

claims.where: Risks and limits: Users can only narrow; What to check
claims.claim: Users cannot enable web search when the administrator disables it.
claims.quote: Users can't turn on the toggle to use web search.

claims.where: What to check: three options; Risks and limits: Option three
claims.claim: The enabled Allow web search in Copilot policy offers three choices.
claims.quote: If the IT admin enables the Allow web search in Copilot policy, they have three options for web search in Copilot:

claims.claim: The Work-mode-disabled, Web-mode-and-Chat-enabled option disables web search in Researcher.
claims.quote: If the IT admin chooses the Disabled in Microsoft Copilot Work mode; Enabled in Microsoft Copilot Web mode and Microsoft Copilot Chat option, web search in Researcher and Cowork in Microsoft Copilot will be disabled.

claims.claim: The Work-mode-disabled, Web-mode-and-Chat-enabled option disables web search in Cowork.
claims.quote: If the IT admin chooses the Disabled in Microsoft Copilot Work mode; Enabled in Microsoft Copilot Web mode and Microsoft Copilot Chat option, web search in Researcher and Cowork in Microsoft Copilot will be disabled.

claims.claim: Domain exclusions can leave results from other verticals, such as news, available for citation.
claims.quote: Results from other answer verticals, such as news, might still be cited.

claims.where: Risks and limits: Domain exclusion is partial
claims.claim: Domain exclusion supports up to 1,000 sites.
claims.quote: By using domain exclusion, you can specify up to 1,000 sites to exclude from web grounding in Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat through a PowerShell script.

claims.where: Risks and limits: Domain exclusion is partial
claims.claim: Domain exclusion supports up to two levels of subdomains.

claims.where: Risks and limits: Domain exclusion is partial; controls[1].note
claims.claim: Updating domain exclusions replaces the old configuration with the newly provided list.
claims.quote: Updating a configuration replaces the old configuration with the newly provided one.

claims.where: Risks and limits: DLP reads the prompt text
claims.claim: The web-search DLP rule detects chosen sensitive information types in text entered directly into the prompt.
claims.quote: Detects when the text entered directly into a Copilot or Cowork prompt contains chosen sensitive information types. The experience blocks the use of external web search as a grounding source for that prompt.

claims.where: Risks and limits: DLP reads the prompt text
claims.claim: When the web-search DLP action blocks external grounding, Copilot still answers using permitted internal Microsoft 365 data.
claims.quote: Copilot still returns a response grounded in internal Microsoft 365 data sources where the user has access.

claims.where: Risks and limits: DLP reads the prompt text
claims.claim: A DLP rule cannot combine content-contains sensitive-information-type and sensitivity-label conditions.
claims.quote: You can't use both content contains sensitive info types and content contains sensitivity labels conditions in the same rule.

claims.claim: Web-search query citations are available only in Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: Web search query citations are available only in Microsoft Copilot Chat.

claims.claim: Web-search query citations are not available in the Copilot pane within Word or PowerPoint.
claims.quote: Citations aren't available in the Copilot pane within a Microsoft 365 app, such as Word or PowerPoint.

claims.claim: Web-search queries are available in the chat thread for only 24 hours.
claims.quote: Also, the web search queries are only available in the chat thread for 24 hours.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 Apps admin center route is Customization > Policy Management > Policy configurations > Create > Start with the basics > Choose the scope > Configure Settings > Allow web search in Copilot.
claims.quote: Under Customization, select Policy Management. ... On the Policy configurations page, select Create. ... On the Start with the basics page ... On the Choose the scope page ... On the Configure Settings page, select the policies

claims.claim: PATCH /beta/copilot/admin/policySettings/microsoft.copilot.allowwebsearch updates the web-search policy setting.
claims.quote: Update the value of a Copilot policy setting. ... PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/policySettings/{id}

claims.claim: The Graph update request body uses the value property to set the policy value.
claims.quote: value | String | The new value to set for the setting. The format is setting-specific and might be a digit, URL, XML string, or JSON string. Required.

claims.claim: The copilotPolicySetting API supports only tenant-level policies.
claims.quote: The API addresses settings individually by their identifier, and only tenant-level policies are supported. User-level and group-level policies aren't supported.

claims.claim: The Graph update requires the delegated CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite permission.
claims.quote: Delegated (work or school account) | CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite | Not available.

claims.claim: The Graph update is supported in the Global service, not US Government L4, L5 (DOD), or China operated by 21Vianet.
claims.quote:
| Global service | US Government L4 | US Government L5 (DOD) | China operated by 21Vianet |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |

claims.claim: The copilotPolicySetting API is currently in preview under beta.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version are subject to change. ... This API is currently in preview.

claims.claim: An admin-center UI for this tenant web-grounding domain-exclusion configuration is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot web search domain exclusion admin center UI ConfigureTenantDomainExclusions. Opened domain-exclusion and configure-copilot-admin-center; no matching UI. Search results for Enterprise Websites and Researcher Computer Use concern different controls.

claims.claim: .\ConfigureTenantDomainExclusions.ps1 -Create -FromFile <csv file> creates the tenant domain-exclusion configuration from CSV.
claims.quote: Create your domain exclusion configuration from a CSV file: ... .\ConfigureTenantDomainExclusions.ps1 -Create -FromFile "input.csv"

claims.claim: Domain-exclusion configuration requires Search Administrator or Global Administrator.
claims.quote: Sign in as a Search Administrator or Global Administrator.

claims.claim: The Purview route is Data Loss Prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Custom > Custom policy > Locations > Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork > rule > Prevent Copilot from processing content > Performing Web Searches.
claims.quote: Go to Data Loss Prevention > Policies and select + Create policy. ... Select the Custom template, then Custom policy. ... On the Locations page ... Add a rule ... In the same rule, set the action to Prevent Copilot from processing content > Performing Web Searches.

claims.claim: New-DlpComplianceRule -Name <rule name> -Policy <policy name> -RestrictWebGrounding $true creates a DLP rule with the web-grounding blocking action.
claims.quote: New-DlpComplianceRule [-Name] <String> -Policy <PolicyIdParameter> ... [-RestrictWebGrounding <Boolean>] ... The RestrictWebGrounding parameter specifies an action for the DLP rule that blocks web grounding. Valid values are: ... $true: Web grounding is blocked.

claims.claim: New-DlpComplianceRule is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.

claims.claim: The sensitive-information-type condition belongs in the same rule as the web-search blocking action.
claims.quote: Add a rule with the Content contains > Sensitive information types condition and choose the SITs you want to detect. ... In the same rule, set the action to Prevent Copilot from processing content > Performing Web Searches.

claims.claim: The user web-search setting is at Microsoft Copilot app > Settings > Personalization > Advanced > Web search.
claims.quote: In the Microsoft Copilot app, open Settings, and then select Personalization. ... Expand Advanced, and turn off the Web search toggle.

claims.claim: An API for the individual user's Web content toggle is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot web content user toggle API Microsoft Graph web search personalization setting. Opened manage-public-web-access and copilotPolicySetting; read enhancedPersonalizationSetting search excerpts. No user web-content API; policySettings is tenant-only.

claims.where: Governance controls: How they interact; What to check
claims.claim: Cloud Policy uses configuration priority to resolve conflicting policies for a user.
claims.quote: If the user is a member of multiple Microsoft Entra groups with conflicting policy settings, priority is used to determine which policy setting is applied. The highest priority is applied, with "0" being the highest priority that you can assign.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Settings > Data access > Web search for Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat links to Cloud Policy in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

Follow the link from Copilot settings to create an Allow web search in Copilot cloud policy in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

claims.claim: Cowork uses the organization's domain-exclusion policies.
